title: VelaFi Chooses AiPrise for Global KYB Across Latin America, the US and Asia
summary: VelaFi, the stablecoin-powered financial infrastructure platform for Latin America, the US and Asia, has chosen AiPrise to power its global KYB.
body_markdown:
[VelaFi](https://velafi.com/) , the stablecoin-powered financial infrastructure platform for businesses moving money across Latin America, the United States and Asia, has chosen AiPrise as its KYB partner. AiPrise now powers VelaFi's global business verification.


## Why VelaFi Chose AiPrise


VelaFi's customers are businesses operating across some of the world's most fragmented registry landscapes. A company incorporated in Mexico, a counterparty in Singapore, and a client in the United States each leave a different paper trail, in a different registry, in a different language. Verifying all of them to one standard, fast enough to keep onboarding moving, is the problem VelaFi brought to AiPrise.


AiPrise verifies businesses against primary sources across 200+ countries, drawing on 100+ data sources, and identifies and screens the owners behind each entity. For VelaFi, that means one platform and one integration for every market it serves, instead of a vendor per country. Our[KYB 101 guide](https://www.aiprise.com/blog/kyb-101) covers why verifying against the registry, rather than the documents alone, matters most in markets like these.


"The businesses we serve are spread across markets where verification works differently in every one. AiPrise gives us one platform that does it properly everywhere."


Hongyi Tang, Global Head of Revenue, VelaFi


Stablecoin rails are making cross-border business payments faster than the compliance behind them. VelaFi is building the infrastructure for that shift, and verifying every business on it properly, everywhere it operates, is part of what makes it work. We are glad to be the partner behind that.


Welcome to AiPrise, VelaFi.


## About VelaFi


VelaFi provides stablecoin-powered financial infrastructure for global businesses: on-ramps and off-ramps, cross-border pay-ins and payouts, and treasury tools, built for companies operating between Latin America, the United States and Asia. Learn more at[VelaFi.com](https://velafi.com/) .


## About AiPrise


AiPrise is the AI-powered global compliance platform: KYB, KYC, AML screening and AI agents in a single API, across 200+ countries.
